visible_text:
若 $0^{\circ}<x<90^{\circ}$，则下列何者必为正确？

I. $\tan x \tan(90^{\circ}-x)=1$

II. $\sin x-\sin(90^{\circ}-x)<0$

III. $\cos x+\cos(90^{\circ}-x)>0$

A. 只有 I 及 II
B. 只有 I 及 III
C. 只有 II 及 III
D. I、II 及 III
reasoning: I is always true because $\tan(90^{\circ}-x)=\cot x$, so $\tan x\tan(90^{\circ}-x)=\tan x\cot x=1$. III is always true because $\cos(90^{\circ}-x)=\sin x$, thus $\cos x+\cos(90^{\circ}-x)=\cos x+\sin x>0$ for $0^{\circ}<x<90^{\circ}$. II is not always true: $\sin x-\sin(90^{\circ}-x)=\sin x-\cos x<0$ only when $x<45^{\circ}$, but fails for $x>45^{\circ}$. Hence only statements I and III are always correct, corresponding to option B.
